blocks.text: Ab rational fraction ki doosri qism: improper rational fraction. Is page par teen kaam hain: (1) improper fraction ko pehchaanna, (2) long division se use polynomial aur proper fraction mein todna, aur (3) woh theorem samajhna jis par partial fractions ke tamaam coefficients nikaalne ka tareeqa khara hai. Teesra hissa aage 5.1.3 mein har sawal mein kaam aayega, is liye use dhyan se parhiye.

Ek rational fraction \(\frac{P(x)}{Q(x)}\) Improper Rational Fraction kehlati hai agar numerator wale polynomial \(P(x)\) ki degree denominator wale polynomial \(Q(x)\) ki degree ke barabar ya us se zyada ho.

Misaal ke taur par \(\frac{x}{2x-3}\), \(\frac{(x-2)(x+1)}{(x-1)(x+4)}\), \(\frac{x^{2}-3}{3x+1}\) aur \(\frac{x^{3}-x^{2}+x+1}{x^{2}+5}\) improper rational fractions, ya mukhtasar mein improper fractions, hain.

blocks.caption: Kitab ki chaar improper fractions ki jaanch

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Improper ka matlab hai "upar ki degree \(\ge\) neeche ki degree". Dhyan dein: degrees barabar hon tab bhi fraction improper hai, bilkul jaise arithmetic mein \(\frac{4}{4}\) aur \(\frac{7}{4}\) dono improper hain.
Doosri misaal \(\frac{(x-2)(x+1)}{(x-1)(x+4)}\) par ghor kijiye: upar do linear factors, neeche bhi do linear factors, is liye dono ki degree \(1 + 1 = 2\). Yeh dekhne mein "saaf suthri" lagti hai, lekin improper hai, is liye isko bhi pehle divide karna parega.
Har improper rational fraction ko division ke zariye mixed form mein badla ja sakta hai, yani ek polynomial aur ek proper rational fraction ke sum ki shakal mein.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Mixed form ka idea aap arithmetic se jaante hain: \(\frac{7}{4} = 1\frac{3}{4}\), yani \(1 + \frac{3}{4}\). Yahan \(1\) poora hissa (whole part) hai aur \(\frac{3}{4}\) proper fraction. Isi tarah improper rational fraction ko divide karne se ek polynomial (poora hissa, quotient) aur ek proper fraction (remainder over divisor) milte hain. Farq sirf itna hai ke numbers ki jagah ab polynomials hain, aur "chhota" ka faisla degree se hota hai. Remainder ki degree hamesha divisor ki degree se kam hoti hai, isi liye bachi hui fraction lazmi proper hoti hai.

Misaal ke taur par \(\frac{3x^{2}+1}{x-2}\) ek improper rational fraction hai (\(2 > 1\)). Long division se humein yeh milta hai:
\[\dfrac{3x^{2}+1}{x-2} = 3x + 6 + \dfrac{13}{x-2}\]

blocks.text_alt: Long division: x minus 2 into 3 x squared plus 1. Quotient 3 x plus 6. First subtract plus or minus 3 x squared, minus or plus 6 x, leaving 6 x plus 1. Then subtract plus or minus 6 x, minus or plus 12, leaving the remainder 13.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke division box mein doosri subtraction wali line \(\pm 6x \;\; 12\) chhapi hai, yani 12 ka sign gaayab hai. Kyun ke \(6(x-2) = 6x - 12\), sahi line \(\pm 6x \mp 12\) hai, aur \((6x + 1) - (6x - 12) = 13\). Upar humne sahi sign ke saath likha hai. Quotient \(3x + 6\) aur remainder 13 kitab mein sahi hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Ab is long division ko line ba line samajhte hain. Yeh bilkul numbers wali lambi taqseem jaisa hai:
1. Dividend ke pehle term \(3x^{2}\) ko divisor ke pehle term \(x\) se divide karein: \(3x\). Ise upar quotient mein likhein.
Kyun: hum yeh dekh rahe hain ke \(x - 2\) ko kis cheez se multiply karein ke sab se bari power \(3x^{2}\) ban jaye.
2. Multiply karein: \(3x(x - 2) = 3x^{2} - 6x\). Ise subtract karein (dono signs badal kar jama karein): \((3x^{2} + 1) - (3x^{2} - 6x) = 6x + 1\).
Kyun: \(3x^{2}\) wala hissa ab "taqseem ho chuka", baqi \(6x + 1\) bacha hai.
3. Phir divide karein: \(6x \div x = 6\). Upar \(+6\) likhein.
4. Multiply karein: \(6(x - 2) = 6x - 12\). Subtract: \((6x + 1) - (6x - 12) = 6x + 1 - 6x + 12 = 13\).
5. Remainder 13 ki degree 0 hai, jo divisor \(x - 2\) ki degree 1 se kam hai, is liye yahan ruk jate hain.
Dhyan dein: \(\pm\), \(\mp\) mein upar wale signs subtract hone wali line dikhate hain aur neeche wale signs badalne ke baad ki shakal. Aur \(3x^{2} + 1\) mein \(x\) wala term nahin, is liye uski jagah khaali chhor di gayi hai, taa ke ek jaisi powers ek hi column mein rahein.
Natija: dividend = divisor × quotient + remainder, yani \(\frac{3x^{2}+1}{x-2} = 3x + 6 + \frac{13}{x-2}\).
Yani improper rational fraction \(\frac{3x^{2} + 1}{x - 2}\) ko ek polynomial \(3x + 6\) aur ek proper rational fraction \(\frac{13}{x - 2}\) ke sum mein badal diya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is jumle mein \(\frac{3x^{2} - 1}{x - 2}\) chhapti hai. Lekin divide to \(\frac{3x^{2} + 1}{x - 2}\) kiya gaya tha. Agar numerator \(3x^{2} - 1\) hota to remainder 13 nahin balke 11 aata. Is liye sahi fraction \(\frac{3x^{2} + 1}{x - 2}\) hai, jaisa humne upar likha.

blocks.title: Tasdeeq
blocks.text:
Jawab ko check karna hamesha acchi aadat hai. \(x = 3\) rakhte hain:
Left side: \(\frac{3(9) + 1}{3 - 2} = \frac{28}{1} = 28\).
Right side: \(3(3) + 6 + \frac{13}{1} = 9 + 6 + 13 = 28\).
Dono barabar, is liye division sahi hai.
Divide karte hi kyun hain? Kyun ke 5.1.3 ka tareeqa sirf proper fractions par chalta hai. Is liye improper fraction mein pehle division karte hain, polynomial wala hissa waise hi rehne dete hain, aur sirf proper hisse ko partial fractions mein torte hain.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Ek chhoti misaal hamari taraf se (kitab ki nahin): \(\frac{x^{2}+1}{x+1}\). Yeh improper hai (\(2 > 1\)).
\(x^{2} \div x = x\); \(x(x+1) = x^{2} + x\); subtract: \((x^{2} + 1) - (x^{2} + x) = -x + 1\).
\(-x \div x = -1\); \(-1(x+1) = -x - 1\); subtract: \((-x + 1) - (-x - 1) = 2\).
Jawab: \(\frac{x^{2}+1}{x+1} = x - 1 + \frac{2}{x+1}\).
Tasdeeq (\(x = 1\)): left \(\frac{2}{2} = 1\), right \(1 - 1 + \frac{2}{2} = 1\). Sahi!
Jab kisi rational fraction ko partial fractions mein alag kiya jata hai, to natija ek identity hota hai; yani yeh identity ke domain mein variable ki har value ke liye sach hota hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: "Domain of identity" ka matlab hai \(x\) ki woh tamaam values jin par dono sides ka matlab banta ho (defined hon). \(\frac{3x^{2}+1}{x-2} = 3x + 6 + \frac{13}{x-2}\) ke liye yeh har \(x \ne 2\) hai, kyun ke \(x = 2\) par denominator zero ho jata hai aur dono taraf fraction bekaar ho jati hai. Baqi har value par dono sides barabar hain, jaise humne \(x = 3\) par dekha.
Partial fractions ke coefficients nikaalne ka saara tareeqa is theorem par khara hai:

"Agar do polynomials variable ki har value ke liye barabar hon, to dono polynomials ki degree ek jaisi hoti hai aur dono polynomials mein variable ki ek jaisi powers ke coefficients barabar hone chahiyein."

Misaal ke taur par,
If \(px^{3} + qx^{2} - ax + b = 2x^{3} - 3x^{2} - 4x + 5,\ \forall\, x\) then \(p = 2\), \(q = -3\), \(a = 4\) and \(b = 5\).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Is misaal ko aise parhiye: dono sides har \(x\) ke liye barabar hain (\(\forall\, x\) ka matlab hai "har \(x\) ke liye"). Is liye har power ke coefficients ka jora milaate hain:
\[x^{3}:\ p = 2\]
\[x^{2}:\ q = -3\]
\[x:\ -a = -4 \Rightarrow a = 4\]
\[\text{constant}:\ b = 5\]
Dhyan dein: \(a = 4\) hai, \(-4\) nahin. Left side par term \(-ax\) hai, is liye poora coefficient \(-a\) milaate hain \(-4\) se, aur \(-a = -4\) se \(a = 4\) aata hai.
Kyun: theorem sach kyun hai? Dono sides ko ek taraf le aayein: \((p-2)x^{3} + (q+3)x^{2} + (4-a)x + (b-5) = 0\), aur yeh har \(x\) ke liye sach hai. Lekin degree 3 ka koi non-zero polynomial zyada se zyada 3 values par hi zero ho sakta hai (uske zyada se zyada 3 roots hote hain). Yahan to yeh har value par zero hai, is liye iske saare coefficients zero hone chahiyein: \(p = 2, q = -3, a = 4, b = 5\).
Aage 5.1.3 mein yahi auzaar har sawal mein chalega: denominators hata kar do barabar polynomials milenge, aur coefficients milaa kar unknown numerators nikal aayenge.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Agar \(3x + 5 \equiv A(x + 1) + B\) ho to \(A\) aur \(B\) kya hain?
Ishaara: right side kholein: \(Ax + (A + B)\). Ab \(x\) ke coefficients aur constants milaayein.
Jawab: \(A = 3\), aur \(A + B = 5\) se \(B = 2\). Tasdeeq: \(3(x + 1) + 2 = 3x + 5\). Bilkul yahi kaam partial fractions mein baar baar hoga.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. \(\frac{P(x)}{Q(x)}\) improper hai jab \(P(x)\) ki degree \(\ge\) \(Q(x)\) ki degree; barabar degrees bhi improper hain.
2. Long division improper fraction ko polynomial + proper fraction bana deti hai: \(\frac{3x^{2}+1}{x-2} = 3x + 6 + \frac{13}{x-2}\).
3. Partial fractions mein sirf proper hissa toda jata hai; polynomial hissa waise hi rehta hai.
4. Partial fractions ka natija identity hai, har us \(x\) par sach jahan dono sides defined hon.
5. Barabar polynomials ki degree ek jaisi aur ek jaisi powers ke coefficients barabar hote hain.
6. Division ka jawab kisi aasan \(x\) par check kar lein.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Barabar degrees wali fraction ko proper samajh lena: \(\frac{x}{2x-3}\) ko pehle divide karna zaroori hai.
2. Long division mein ghaib power ki khaali jagah na chhorna (\(3x^{2} + 1\) mein \(x\) wala term nahin), jis se alag alag powers aapas mein ghata di jati hain.
3. Subtract karte waqt sirf pehle term ka sign badalna: \((6x + 1) - (6x - 12) = 13\) hai, \(-11\) nahin. Bachne ka tareeqa: poori line ko bracket mein rakh kar har sign badlein.
4. \(-ax = -4x\) se \(a = -4\) likh dena: poora coefficient milaayein, \(-a = -4\), is liye \(a = 4\).
